scope: Selected aggregate-framing checks only. These decisions do not certify complete ADRs or the underlying leaf features.

decisions.review: Keep PDF colour-space semantics and device rendering policy separate. The source requires colour reproduction for a rendering processor but explicitly makes separation simulation optional and points device calibration/halftoning to Clause 10. Do not promote an unimplemented printer-specific effect into a universal colour-space reader defect.
decisions.status: No new departure or defect found; leaf evidence remains distributed among colour and rendering shards.

decisions.topic: One downstream pipeline for marks and image samples
decisions.review: Images ignore the current graphics-state colour parameter when selecting source samples, but later colour-processing stages treat those samples like SC/sc values. This supports shared conversion plumbing while retaining image-specific Decode/mask/SMask semantics. Do not collapse the two stages into one source-value rule.
decisions.status: Aggregate framing is consistent with separate image and colour-space owners; no new cross-family regression established.

decisions.topic: Ignored operations in d1 glyphs and uncoloured patterns
decisions.review: The restriction is a runtime interpretation rule for specific content contexts. Tests need actual downstream paint/state assertions and controls; dictionary parse acceptance alone is weak. The source permits image masks while suppressing other image painting. EC3 #551 changed a producer-side Table 73 CS resource shape statement; it does not require a reader to reject name-valued forms.
decisions.status: Existing narrow assertions support selected routes; full operator/image enumeration remains unreviewed. No blanket conformance conclusion.

decisions.topic: Font aggregate rows do not supersede leaf audit
decisions.review: Text positioning, font data, glyph rendering and extraction have distinct consumers. Aggregate tests can substantiate a connection between paths but cannot substitute for leaf semantics. The current shard evidence has explicit residuals for encoding/CMaps, extraction, rendering, and tagged text.
decisions.status: No independently omitted overview algorithm identified in this pass.
